## Background

I'm a senior at the **University of California, Los Angeles**, pursuing degrees in **Mathematics/Economics** and **Statistics & Data Science**, with an expected graduation date of June 2027.

I'm interested in how quantitative analysis can inform business decisions. Whether it's building a data pipeline, evaluating a machine learning model, or working through a business problem, I enjoy finding ways to turn complex information into practical insights.

My experiences have taken me across consulting, data analytics, software engineering, and entrepreneurship, giving me opportunities to approach problems from both technical and business perspectives.

## Leadership & Involvement

Outside of my professional experience, I'm involved in **Bruin Catalyst Consulting**, a student-led consulting organization at UCLA that I helped establish.

As Founder, President, and Project Lead, I've worked on building the organization, recruiting and developing members, and leading consulting engagements for startups and small businesses.

It's been an opportunity to combine my interests in business strategy, analytics, and team leadership while working with other students.

## Beyond Work & Academics

I'm particularly interested in the intersection of economics, technology, and business strategy. I enjoy exploring new analytical tools, learning about different industries, and finding practical applications for what I study.

Outside of school and work, I enjoy staying active through weightlifting, pickleball, and hiking. I'm also a big fan of movies, traveling, and exploring new places.
